label: lecture
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the named lectures he delivered in the first decade of the 2000s, in chronological order (events with the same date in any order).
why_needs_multiple: Bảy buổi thuyết giảng có tên trong cùng một thập niên, ở nhiều đại học và hội.
criterion: delivered a named lecture (Hettner, Murrin, Progress, Appleton, Von Humboldt, Gordon Manley, Gunning) during 2000-2009

gold_events.text: Delivered Hettner Lectures, University of Heidelberg
Delivered Murrin Lectures, University of British Columbia
Delivered Progress in Human Geography Lecture, RGS
Delivered Appleton Lecture, University of Hull
Delivered Gordon Manley Lecture, Royal Holloway
Delivered Gunning Lecture, University of Edinburgh

label: award
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the named awards and medals he received from learned societies, in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Bốn huy chương/giải thưởng từ các hội khoa học ở các năm khác nhau.
criterion: received a named award or medal from a learned society (RGS Back Award, RSGS Centenary Medal, RIA Gold Medal, RGS Founders' Medal); honorary degree and CBE excluded

gold_events.text: Received Back Award from Royal Geographical Society.
Received Centenary Medal from Royal Scottish Geographical Society.
Received Gold Medal from Royal Irish Academy.
Received Founders’ Medal from Royal Geographical Society.
